lines.t: I walk through shadows I made on my own
Carrying burdens that cut to the bone
But your voice broke through the silence and fear
Saying, child, come closer
I am here
Grace like rain, it came to fall
Washing the room and healing it all
Forgiveness, flowing like rivers of thorns
Lived in the way till the sorrow is gone
Your mercy rewrites every story I've known
In the light of forgiveness, I'm finally home
I once believed I was lost to the flame
Running from truth, hiding my name
But love remembered what I could not see
That mercy was always calling to me
Every scar becomes a sign
Of a heart restored, of a holy design
Forgiveness thrown like rivers of dawn
Left in the way till the song is gone
Your mercy rewrites every story I've known
In the light of forgiveness, so I'm finally home
Let every train fall into the sea
Let every heart be set free
I lay it all down, I let it go
Love is the truth that I now know
Forgiveness flowing like rivers of dawn
Lived in the way till the sorrow is gone
Your mercy rewrites every story I've known
In the light of forgiveness, I'm finally home
In your love, I am found
And for this, I am home
